page.layout: Running head at top centre: "Elenchus." Below it, one column of 22 short summary entries, each ending in a section number, with a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Personale Petri privilegium nullo jure transferri in Papam.§.6.
Bernardi judicium sæpè etiam ab Aduersariis contemni.§.7.
Cypriani authoritate, de more suo rhetoricantis, abuti Bellarminum.§.8.
Cypriannm[?] dictis factis Rom. Cathedræ acerrimum oppugnatorem fuisse.§.9.
Sacerdotis Vet.Testamenti judicio, nisi juxta legem acquiescendum non fuisse.§.11.
Per [Mosis Cathedram] non propriam Judicis sententiam, sed doctrinam Mosaicam indicari.§.12.
Expositiones Pontificiorum deliramentis Rabbinorum insulsorum perquam esse similes, ad cæcam obedientiam inducendam.§.13.
Lutherum Pontificiorum partes, propter impiam Pontificis doctrinam, in novis fidei Articulis condendis, jure deseruisse.§.14.
Lutherum ovem innocentem, tum Pastorem bonum agnosci posse.§.16.
Summam regulam interpretandi legem non esse absolutè penes Pontificem Rom.§.17.
De Luthero reo, deque occasione, & modo iniquo aduersus illum procedendi.§.18.
Indulgentiarum doctrinam longè abesse à veritate, antiquitate, pietate.§.19.
Bellarmini, de Aquilone, sarcasma contra Prophetæ mentem perperam deprauari.§.20.
Lutheri doctrinâ Principum incolumitatem & dignitatem maximè muniri.§.21.
Titulum Apostoli Caluino nos nullum tribuere, quem Papæ prærogativam esse adulatorie astruunt Pontificii.§.22.

page.notes: Printed "Cypriannm" in entry 4 is read as is; it may be a misprint for "Cyprianum" and is marked [?]. The printed "Eccles.12" has a space in the scan. The printed "s" forms have been normalised to plain s. A few entries are set in small capitals (for example "Aqvilone"), which were transcribed in ordinary letters. No page number is printed.
